description.value: Serious Coffee is a locally-owned BC franchise chain founded in Duncan in 1994, now operating 16 locations across Vancouver Island, Powell River, and New Westminster. The brand distinguishes itself through an air roasting process applied to premium Arabica beans, producing a smoother, less bitter cup than conventional drum roasting. The Nanaimo Jingle Pot Road location offers a full menu of espresso drinks, cold beverages, teas, and fresh baked goods sourced from the company's own bakery adjacent to its Cowichan Valley roasting plant.
